SQL_DOC.P_SQL: MERGE INTO EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_PRE_ENTER_IF_S A USING ( SELECT SEQ, CENTER_CD, PUR_ID, PUR_ITM_ID, ERP_COMP_CD, COMP_CD FROM SAMYANGGROUP_PO_IF_R WHERE SEQ = $SEQ$ AND RTRIM(ERP_COMP_CD)+'OP'+PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND PUR_LINE_NUM = $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SEND_YN = 'N', MOD_DT = GETDATE(), KEP_REAL_SUPPLY_DT = $KEP_REAL_SUPPLY_DT$, KEP_PRE_ENTER_SUP_NM = $KEP_PRE_ENTER_SUP_NM$ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SEQ, PROC_TYPE, CENTER_CD, PUR_ID, PUR_ITM_ID, ERP_COMP_CD, COMP_CD, SEND_YN, INPUT_EMP_NO, INPUT_DT, KEP_REAL_SUPPLY_DT, KEP_PRE_ENTER_SUP_NM ) VALUES ( $SEQ$, 'C', $CENTER_CD$, B.PUR_ID, B.PUR_ITM_ID, B.ERP_COMP_CD, B.COMP_CD, 'N', B.INPUT_EMP_NO, GETDATE(), $KEP_REAL_SUPPLY_DT$, $KEP_PRE_ENTER_SUP_NM$ )
